:::{#def-cv-estimate}
#### Cross-validation estimate

Let $\foldof{i}$ be the [fold assignment](#def-folds) of observation $i$
in [$k$-fold cross-validation](#def-kfold),
and let $\fittedwo{j}{\cdot}$ be the prediction rule
fitted to all observations except those in fold $\fold{j}$.
The **$k$-fold cross-validation estimate**
of the [expected generalization error](#def-expected-generalization-error)
at the sizes of the training sets it fits to
is the [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of the predictions that each observation receives
from the rule fitted without its fold:

$$
\cvest{k} \eqdef \frac{1}{n} \sumin \sqf{\fittedwo{\foldof{i}}{x_i} - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-cv-estimate}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@james2021islr2e [sec. 5.1.3] for the average of fold mean squared errors;
@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1] for the per-observation form with the fold index $\foldof{i}$.
:::
